main_text.p: do, vel nondum scirent, vel ut jejunû nec rutum satis Schismaticorū telis excipiendis, repudiarent. Nam fuêre in Romana & Occidentali Ecclesia, post Novatianos illos fluctus excitatos, Hilarios ante & Ambrosios &c. oppidò pauci, alicujus nominis & eruditionis scriptores, qui exil-lis sese angustijs & difficultatibus vale-rent expedire. Post modùm verò, inde ab Hilario, & Ambrosio, & Augustino, do-ctissimi Latinorum, interpretamen-tum illud de Baptismo adoptare, quam Epistolæ repudium mittere malue-runt.

XIV. Tertio, damus pariter de Epistola inter Latinos controversum, quarto seculo, & Arrianis temporibus. Nova scilicet haesitandi occasione ab haereticis oblata. Urgebant Christi τὸ ὁμοούσιον καὶ ἀΐδιον [?] everti, non uno Epistolæ loco. V.g. Capite 1. versu 3, dum dicitur χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως· καὶ ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ. page.notes: The Greek phrase after "Christi" is partly illegible in the scan; "ἀΐδιον" is a best reading and marked [?]. The Greek in the Hebrews 1:3 quotation is copied as printed, accents included, but its exact accents are uncertain. "rutum" is printed as such and may be a misprint for "ratum". The word "Epistolæ" carries a ligature. The large "XIV." is a numbered thesis and is therefore a paragraph, not a heading.
